title: "we're here for the tree" 😭 @Celine Dion #IAmCelineDion @Prime Video ...
transcript: and thanks to you my fans your presence in my journey has been a gift beyond measure your never ending love and support over all these years have delivered me tothis moment tonight one of the stories you will hear from me in this movie as I was reading, learning about my condition I compared myself-- and I'm not saying this because we're in New York but I compared myself toan apple i know, literally sounds like we made it up but I I did (say that) and i was in Las Vegas so when I said to myself that i compared myself to an apple from a tree I don't want you to wait in line anymore if I don't have any shiny apples for you so a couple of days ago I saw a message from a fan and it said: "we're not here for the apples" "we're here for the tree" I cannot I cannot believe how fortunate I am to havemy fans in my life this movie is my love letter to each of you I hope to see you all again very very soon
